preferredSummary: Khalid Saqr builds systems that make research, simulation, evidence, and intellectual property easier for machines to read and humans to trust.
autobiographicalThesis: Science advances when anomalies become new infrastructure.
identityDescription: Khalid Saqr is a computational scientist, systems engineer, author and founder. His research spans fluid dynamics, turbulence, neurovascular haemodynamics, mechanobiology and scientific knowledge systems.
